> Michael Handyman is a professional home and office maintenance and repair service run by Michael, offering a personal, friendly, and reliable approach. The brand emphasizes quality workmanship, a smile, and fair pricing. Services include installations (TVs, shelves, curtains), furniture assembly (especially IKEA), light plumbing, and basic electrical work. The business promotes a referral program offering 20% discounts and positions itself as a trusted neighborhood handyman who comes to your door.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About מיכאל הנדימן
Michael Handyman is a professional home and office maintenance and repair service run by Michael, offering a personal, friendly, and reliable approach. The brand emphasizes quality workmanship, a smile, and fair pricing. Services include installations (TVs, shelves, curtains), furniture assembly (especially IKEA), light plumbing, and basic electrical work. The business promotes a referral program offering 20% discounts and positions itself as a trusted neighborhood handyman who comes to your door.

## Target Audience
- homeowners and office owners needing repairs and maintenance
- בעלי בתים זקוקים לתיקונים
- בעלי משרדים זקוקים לתחזוקה
- סוכני נדל"ן לפני מכירה

## Industry
home maintenance and repair
